headline: Cayman Islands: +3.8% growth in 2024
sections: Cayman Islands is a $7.8 billion economy (2024), the world's 163rd-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +3.8% in 2024, close to the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $92K at purchasing-power parity (2024), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 0.9% of GDP (2024).
